result.description:
An outstanding opportunity has emerged for a dedicated  General Practitioner  to join a thriving practice in  Toronto  on the New South Wales Central Coast. Toronto is a lakeside suburb in the Lake Macquarie Council Area, a 30 minute drive from Newcastle CBD. This role is available for both  full-time and part-time applicants , offering the chance to assist with a large and growing patient base in a  mixed-billing  environment. 

 The practice, housed in a modern, purpose-built facility, features 13 consultation rooms, 2 procedure rooms, and 3 fully-equipped treatment bays. You will be supported by a team of nine doctors and three  experienced full-time nurses , including specialists in health management and diabetes education. An efficient and  supportive administrative team  ensures a smooth workflow, allowing you to focus on high-quality patient care. 

 This position grants  clinical autonomy  and  flexible working arrangements , empowering you to balance your professional and personal life. The practice offers robust support for continued professional development (CPD) and provides  supervisor opportunities  for those interested in mentoring GP registrars. The location is in a  DPA-approved area , making it ideal for a wide range of candidates. 

 Working in Toronto offers an exceptional  lifestyle , with a community known for its water sports, dining, and live entertainment. This role allows you to build a rewarding career while enjoying a fantastic lakeside lifestyle, just a short drive from the Newcastle CBD.   Apply Now

result.description:
MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Ward Clerk - Emergency Department



 Apply now
 Job no: 941542

 Work type: Part time

 Location: Fleurieu Peninsula

 Categories: Administration, Business and Management





 

Barossa Hills Fleurieu Local Health Network 

Southern Fleurieu Health Service (Victor Harbor) 

Salary: ASO2 $66,442 - $69,504 (Adjusted to hours worked) 

Part-time, 30 hours per week, 7-day roster - Temporary up to 30 Sep 2026 

WHAT ARE WE OFFERING? 

This role supports the delivery of high-quality customer service by providing courteous and efficient interactions with patients, visitors, staff and the wider community. You will deliver essential administrative support, including patient admissions, medical records management, and coordination of communication systems, while ensuring accuracy, attention to detail and a positive patient experience. 

As part of a collaborative team, you will contribute to effective administrative operations through data entry, record keeping and general office support, while participating in quality improvement activities. The role also requires a strong commitment to workplace health and safety, adherence to policies and procedures, and maintaining records in line with required standards. 

WHO ARE WE? 

The Barossa Hills Fleurieu Local Health Network offers opportunities across our sites, from Kangaroo Island to Eudunda, wrapping all the way around our metropolitan areas (position based in Victor Harbor). We pride ourselves on providing exceptional care to all our consumers, residents, their families, and community. Our mission is to ensure that you always receive the best quality, safe, consistent, collaborative care and always with kindness. We do this by maintaining exceptional levels of care at all times supported by systems and processes that assure us of quality and safety of our staff and those we serve. 

WHERE AND HOW YOU WILL WORK 

Victor Harbor offers a coastal lifestyle like no other, combining ocean views, outdoor living, and a welcoming community. With a strong local services hub and a relaxed pace of life, it's an ideal location for those seeking meaningful work alongside a change of scenery. For more information Discover Victor Harbor 

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR? 

Do you consistently deliver courteous, professional customer service in both face-to-face and phone interactions? 

Do you have strong attention to detail when managing patient records, admissions and data entry tasks? 

Are you able to communicate effectively and work collaboratively within a team environment? 

Can you prioritise tasks and maintain efficiency in a busy administrative setting? 

Do you demonstrate a commitment to workplace safety, policies, and continuous improvement? 

If you have answered yes to any of these questions - then read on. 

 HOW WILL YOU CONTRIBUTE?

Safety Advisor / Occupational Health and Safety Advisor – Full-Time
Location: Welshpool, Western Australia 6106
Employment Type: Full-Time
Salary: $100,000 – $130,000 per annum (depending on skills and experience)

MINPROVISE INTERNATIONAL PTY LTD is a leading total solutions provider delivering specialist maintenance and shutdown services, engineering, fabrication, project services, and sustaining capital works. We also provide a comprehensive range of equipment and products, supporting the mining, oil & gas, and construction industries across Australia and internationally.

We are currently seeking an experienced and motivated Safety Advisor / Occupational Health and Safety Advisor to join our growing team on a full-time basis.

About the Role
As a Safety Advisor / Occupational Health and Safety Advisor, you will be responsible for supporting the implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of workplace health and safety systems across mining, engineering, maintenance, fabrication, and industrial projects. You will work closely with project managers, supervisors, employees, and contractors to ensure compliance with legislation, company policies, and client safety requirements.

Key Responsibilities
•	Implement, maintain, and monitor workplace health and safety systems, policies, and procedures.
•	Provide advice and guidance to management, supervisors, and employees on occupational health and safety matters.
•	Conduct workplace inspections, audits, risk assessments, and safety observations.
•	Identify workplace hazards and recommend appropriate control measures to minimise risks.
•	Assist with incident investigations, reporting, root cause analysis, and corrective actions.
•	Develop, review, and maintain safety documentation, including SWMS, JSA, risk assessments, and safety reports.
•	Monitor compliance with WHS legislation, Australian Standards, client requirements, and company procedures.
•	Deliver safety inductions, toolbox talks, and training sessions to employees and contractors.
•	Promote a strong safety culture and encourage continuous improvement in workplace practices.
•	Assist project teams with safety planning, mobilisation requirements, and compliance documentation.
•	Maintain safety records, registers, inspection reports, and incident databases.
•	Liaise with clients, contractors, and regulatory bodies regarding health and safety matters where required.
•	Ensure compliance with workplace health, safety, environmental, and quality management systems.

Skills and Experience
•	Minimum 1-2 years of full-time experience as a Safety Advisor, Occupational Health and Safety Advisor, or similar WHS role.
•	Relevant qualification in Occupational Health and Safety, Workplace Health and Safety, or a related discipline.
•	Strong knowledge of Australian WHS legislation, safety management systems, and risk management principles.
•	Experience working within mining, construction, engineering, maintenance, or industrial environments is highly regarded.
•	Ability to conduct workplace inspections, audits, investigations, and safety training.
•	Strong communication, consultation, and problem-solving skills.
•	Excellent attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities.
•	Ability to work independently and collaboratively with project teams.
•	Proficiency in Microsoft Office and safety management systems.

What We Offer
•	Full-time, permanent employment.
•	Competitive salary of $100,000 – $130,000 per annum.
•	Opportunities to work on major mining, shutdown, engineering, and industrial projects.
•	Ongoing professional development and career progression.
•	Supportive team environment with long-term career opportunities.
